notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Little Bear with haste.
When the token Little Bear enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Little Bear trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Little Bear.
Repeat.
